findings.fix: Make the wrapper unary: `def azimuthalAverage (g : TransversePlane → ℝ) (kT : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.circleAverage (g ∘ Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr) 0 kT`. Then `azimuthalTmd` becomes `fun i x kT Q2 ζ => if kT < 0 then 0 else azimuthalAverage (fun v => Φ v i x Q2 ζ) kT`, `azimuthalAverage_nonneg` can be dropped in favour of `Real.circleAverage_nonneg_of_nonneg` applied at the one call site in `azimuthalTmd_isTmdDensity`, and `azimuthalAverage_eq_zero_of_odd` generalises to `(hf : ∀ w, g (-w) = -g w) : azimuthalAverage g kT = 0`, which still gives `azimuthalAverage_areaForm_eq_zero` in one line.
findings.issue: `azimuthalAverage` threads three spectator arguments (`x`, `Q2`, `ζ`) that no part of the definition touches, so two of the six new declarations are Mathlib lemmas re-exported through the wrapper: `azimuthalAverage_eq_integral` (lines 86-90) is proved by the term `Real.circleAverage_def` itself, and `azimuthalAverage_nonneg` (lines 119-124) is `Real.circleAverage_nonneg_of_nonneg` with the spectators appended — and with a hypothesis strengthened to global nonnegativity in all four arguments, where upstream only needs `∀ x ∈ Metric.sphere 0 |kT|, 0 ≤ f x`.

summary: The circle-average content genuinely reuses Mathlib, but `azimuthalAverage` carries three spectator arguments that exist only to re-export `Real.circleAverage_def` and `Real.circleAverage_nonneg_of_nonneg` as a parallel TMD-namespace API, and `radialVector_norm_of_nonneg` is a consumer-less one-step specialization of the preceding lemma.
